verdict.rationale: BILL's Spend & Expense marketing claims AI-powered spend management in which every transaction is "categorized" and "automatically compliant." Separately, the pricing page lists AI multi-line bill coding through an Invoice Coding Agent, but that is AP invoice coding rather than expense coding. The evidence is a thin marketing claim, with no documentation of how the AI codes or audits expenses. Missing for 10: AI receipt reading/OCR for expenses, AI-suggested memos, duplicate-expense detection, expense fraud detection, in-depth first-party docs on the AI categorization, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI codes and audits expenses for me — reading receipts, suggesting categories and memos, and catching duplicates or fraud

citations.quote: smart, flexible cards paired with AI-powered spend management —so every transaction is controlled, categorized, and automatically compliant
